week_selection.method: SHA-256(candidate-01-v21-dc-mss-retest:<0..2>) modulo the remaining ordered Monday pool; frozen before execution

execution_data: official Binance Vision aggregate trades as one-for-one TradeTick

scenario.information_clock: daily causal equal-notional target representing one minute of the immediately preceding completed UTC day
scenario.failed_sweep: confirmed same-side directional-change pivot sweeps prior same-side pivot, confirmation closes back inside, initiative and reversal flow signs oppose
scenario.mss: completed event close breaks the nearer of the two latest opposing confirmed pivots with aligned aggressive-flow z-score sign
scenario.entry_confirmation: a later completed event retests the broken pivot and closes rejected on the new side with aligned aggressive flow
scenario.invalidation: post-MSS retest-path adverse extreme plus the unchanged 7-bps side-cost buffer
scenario.target: the farther of the two latest opposing confirmed pivots
scenario.state_expiry: target consumption, failed-boundary reacceptance, broken-pivot reacceptance, contrary directional change, or supersession; no fixed fitted time window

second_and_third_week_policy: run unchanged only when the preceding frozen week advances
long_evaluation_policy: open only after all three frozen weeks advance without logic or parameter changes
